CC0 1.0 Universal

The synthetic audio fixtures in this directory are dedicated to the public
domain under CC0 1.0 Universal. They contain only mathematical sine waves
generated by scripts/generate-fixtures.py, silence, and intentionally invalid
test bytes. They contain no recordings, performances, or third-party music.

License text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

FFmpeg and encoders are generation tools, not redistributed in this directory.
Their own licenses remain applicable to their binaries and source code.
